mapper.select: SELECT * FROM page_objects ORDER BY created_at DESC
SELECT * FROM page_objects WHERE platform = #{platform} ORDER BY created_at DESC
SELECT * FROM page_objects WHERE app_id = #{appId} ORDER BY created_at DESC
SELECT * FROM page_objects WHERE app_id = #{appId} AND platform = #{platform} ORDER BY page_path, created_at DESC
SELECT * FROM page_objects WHERE platform = #{platform} AND app_id = #{appId} AND page_path = #{pagePath} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO page_objects (id, name, description, platform, app_id, page_path, catalog, elements, created_by, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{name}, #{description}, #{platform}, #{appId}, #{pagePath}, #{catalog}, #{elements, typeHandler=com.mobile.standalone.mapper.typehandler.JsonMapTypeHandler}, #{createdBy}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE page_objects SET name = #{name}, description = #{description}, page_path = #{pagePath}, catalog = #{catalog}, elements = #{elements, typeHandler=com.mobile.standalone.mapper.typehandler.JsonMapTypeHandler}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{id}
